page.title: Tech Beach Mama
page.subTitle: Inpirational Web page for Women who want to start a Tech Career
page.text: Tech Beach Mama is a high-converting personal brand website designed and developed in Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. It blends clean, modern aesthetics with conversion-focused UX to attract and engage aspiring tech-minded mothers. The platform showcases educational resources, a newsletter funnel, and digital products — all structured to inspire single mothers to gain financial freedom through web development, UI/UX design, and project management. Built with scalability and performance in mind, Tech Beach Mama is more than a website — it’s a movement empowering women to design a life they love, both online and by the beach.
